claim: The visual viewer should use a page renderer with a coordinated text layer instead of a raster image plus reconstructed text.
Converted PowerPoint slides can share the PDF viewer path with PDFs while the existing PresentationML parser remains an indexing fallback.
Fit-to-window should be computed from intrinsic page dimensions and available viewer dimensions.
Text-selection handling should read the active Range and normalize its client rectangles against the exact rendered page wrapper.
